REGIONAL CROSS-CHECK for this year: WER 1991;66(19): 'the disease reappeared in Ghana, which had not reported an outbreak since 1986'. Togo's absence therefore falls in the WEAKER case: a land neighbour was in epidemic while Togo notified nothing, which is possible but demands a stronger source than WHO silence in years when WHO itself reported under-declaration; confidence lowered and the discordance recorded here rather than hidden.
